review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a new, integrated, and substantially narrower submission.

execution_evidence.reviewer_audit: Source/result inspection and aggregate recomputation from committed JSON.

resolved_or_materially_improved: Finite NDU raw and guarded neural policies pass the predeclared finite-model targets for all three seeds.
Neural dynamic-game profiles pass full finite-game player-specific payoff-loss targets in all six principal cases.
The old high-dimensional training-domain coverage failure is measured and wide-domain follow-ups are supplied.
A separate mpmath.iv implementation corroborates the scalar interval arithmetic.
Immutable source/evidence provenance, raw arrays, actor snapshots, environment data and tests are retained.
blocking_findings: No integrated R7 manuscript exists; ECTA.tex and supp.tex remain the R6 blobs.
Finite actors are supervised by exhaustive all-action or all-joint-action Bellman values and exact labels.
Matched NDU evidence does not show an NBO advantage over direct neural fitting or classical dynamic programming.
Finite-model certificates have no computed continuous state/action/time or continuous-equilibrium transfer error.
High-dimensional coverage results remain policy-evaluation diagnostics without optimal-value or continuous-time error bounds.
The independent interval replay remains scalar and reuses the stored leaf cover.
The paper remains too broad relative to the isolated numerical contribution.

limitations: This is not an actual journal-appointed report or editorial decision.
The reviewer did not independently rerun the complete R7 training suite; execution claims refer to the pinned successful workflow and committed evidence.
The development-branch supplementary protocol is not counted as evidence.
Finite-model certificates are not interpreted as continuous-model guarantees.
No inference about author intent is made.
